description: Right shift wider than the machine word. Formerly an accepted deviation (issue #810 item 4.7): hgraph raised where released hgraph shifts a Python unbounded integer right by 70 and yields 0. Every such answer is representable in 64 bits -- 0, or -1 where the sign bit fills an arithmetic shift -- so hgraph now gives it and the two AGREE. The recipe is kept to pin that agreement; its known-divergence entry is gone.
